spec.structural_change: QC-A0 10-24 a0 v8 (from v7; QC A0 congestion analysis /tmp/qc/a0cong: v7 W/E LSL-column cuts 1.41/1.58 (NK) x tracks from the head ring banks hopping 650-710 um to their readers at the far pin faces; fix F1, STRUCTURAL, no squeeze/density/derate/clock relax): (1) each head's rung-0 landed crossing co-located in the hub (the empty LSL slot): ring writers u_qlw2w/e AND readers u_qlr2c/w/e (incl. the flattened reader output flops g_tx9.tc[], which v7's '/'-only regex missed -> catch-all) in one INCLUSIVE hub sub-box per head (3 x 3 array mirroring the LSL array; l2c writer in the slot's own cell), so the 4-slot banks (2 x 512 b + 600 b) never leave the hub; only the 390-b rung-1 word crosses to the face (register -> wire -> register, kept g_r[1].u_tx in an INCLUSIVE face box with u_qlw3 + the leaf reset relay); (2) E LSL column g_sl[3,6,7] mirrored MY at the same origin (lattice 235.008 = n x 0.048/0.064/0.036/0.054) so its pin faces look W into the 35-um channel beside the hub instead of the 20-um E die margin; (3) u_qlr3 at the face except sl3 (-> NW hub sub-box: face->t_out leg); (4) catch-all EXCLUSIVE hub box + its 4-um seam removed: control regs FREE; (5) clock: v7 taps kept, the 2 taps F1 empties (E margin) moved into the hub + 4 hub additions (sink density, decision 5 (b); gen_a0c8_taps.py), reset copies to the tap nearest their v8 loads. Outline, signal pins, RTL body, cycles = v7 (RTL: load-less tap ports only). Cut model (tools/qwen_romleaf/a0core/budget, results/geom_review): W/E col NK 1.41/1.58 -> 0.35/0.16, NL 1.65/1.58 -> 0.49/0.17. QC-A0 10-24 a0 v7 (from v6; CP1 r8 RULING COORD 10-23 21:26: grid taps are the die-wide method, sink taps only as ADDITIONS): 38 interior M7 taps = R4 grid 6 (2 x 3 at 400 um, tap_clear >= 8.64 um off the hard children, gen_a0c7_taps.py) + the 32 v6 sink-anchored taps; PRE_CTS = the current tools/die_plan clock_taps.tcl + tap_balance.tcl (OT_TAP_PORT ck / OT_TAP_CLOCK core_clk; no private copies), cap 1500, balance to 250. Reset landing copies FIRM at their v6 tap (renamed). Outline, regions, signal pins, RTL body, cycles = v6. QC-P6-A0 10-23 a0 v6 (from v5; GEOM-REVIEW7 18:34 FAIL: 17/24 v5 trees > 290 ps, ROM-spine 1-D strips of 2-4k sinks per tap): 32 SINK-ANCHORED interior M7 taps (KV-P6-TAP tools/die_plan/taps.py k-medians @c1bae2221 on the v5 PLACED flops, cap 1500, reach p99 <= 150 / max <= 180 um, 0 empty; gen_a0c6_taps.py), PRE_CTS cap 1500 (a0_clock_taps6.tcl), post-CTS balance to the plan insertion 250 ps (not the longest tree clamped at 290), reset landing copies FIRM at their nearest tap (a0_reset_taps6.tcl). Outline, regions, signal pins, RTL body, cycles = v5. QC-P5 10-23 a0 v4 (from v3; COORD A0-clock concern): CLOCK TAP GRID. v2 NK measured 1,133 ps core insertion from one ck pin (probe: 17-level TritonCTS top tree to 48 k-means roots 558 ps + 313 ps balance pads + 115 ps local trees). v4: 20 interior M7 clock tap ports ck + ck_t1..ck_t19 (RTL OT_A0_CK_TAPS, no RTL loads) at equal-sink-count centroids of the v2 placed sinks (~2.2k sinks, <= 265 um reach each; the die spine drops M8 -> M7 onto them); PRE_CTS a0_clock_taps.tcl moves every sink to its nearest tap (die_plan clock_taps.tcl @71e64b85e, cap 3000 sinks), post-CTS tap balance to 250 +/- 40 ps; no k-means top tree. GPL routability-driven mode dropped (v2 NK/NL both diverged at overflow 0.19 with +57-71% routability inflation and reverted; NK legal HPWL 7.52 m vs a0ck 3.87 m without it). Regions, outline, signal pins, RTL body, cycles = v3. QC-P4 10-23 a0 v3 (from v2): v2 initial-GRT probe left hotspot 2 hot (NK 3,417 / NL 5,268 overflow in x220-320 y700-740); dwr/der L9 writer boxes 2x taller (660.6-760.6) and the hub box moved up to y 764.6-829 plus the LSL row-0/1 gap band (y 819.7-829) W and E, so the writers spread and the hub no longer stacks on them. QC-P3 10-23 a0 v2 (from a0ck): L1 ring readers co-located with their writers (regions only; GEOM 11:44 hotspots (230,410)/(220-320,720)), GPL routability-driven. Same RTL, outline, pins, clock. QC-A0 10-23 (FALLBACK: one core clock ck, 48 k-means local roots (clock_split_km.tcl) under one TritonCTS top tree): A0 planned hard core of the Qwen compute variant-B plan (CB quad, 4 cores at (86.4|699.84, 77.76|1382.4), 457.92 x 1157.76, one spine tap per core). Same rpf floorplan, children, regions, request decoders, RTL body and cycles as qfd_tile_nk_romleaf_rpf@fce5d5cb2; the 35/39 clock-entry ports become internal nets of ck (r3 NL setup -169/-425 ps were 100% inter-entry crossings under 210 ps inter-entry uncertainty).

spec.slot_change_request: QC-A0 10-24 v8: core clock = the v7 tap pins with 2 moved + 4 added in the hub (tools/qwen_romleaf/a0core/qfd_tile_nk_a0c8_pins.tcl, a0c8_nk_taps.json); declare per CB quad in physical/die_plan/qwen_compute/inputs/a0_core_taps.json (variants updated to the v8 kits). QC-P6-A0 10-23 v6: core clock = 32 interior M7 tap pins (tools/qwen_romleaf/a0core/qfd_tile_nk_a0c6_pins.tcl), each a die-spine M8->M7 drop at the plan insertion; declared per CB quad in physical/die_plan/qwen_compute/inputs/a0_core_taps.json. QC-P5 10-23 v4: core clock = 20 interior M7 tap pins (tools/qwen_romleaf/a0core/qfd_tile_nk_a0c4_pins.tcl), each a die-spine drop at equal arrival (80 per CB quad); the E-face ck pin is gone. QC-A0 10-23: core outline/pins = rpf (plan contents u_t00..u_t11); clock ports ck_* removed, one ck at E (457.824, 668.076). Report to QC-P2: core tap = ck pin, budget measured at gate.

pin_regs.reason: Actual RTL already samples tap/tile_id/rst_n on ck_fa4, n_a/n_b on their face roots and launches t_out/n_y on their face roots; node-less twin omits n_* ports. Preserve these proved native stages and their fixed calendar; tie_hi/tie_lo are constant straps. Additional generic wrapper stages would duplicate the existing registers. Native all-pin timing still required.

safe_design_checklist.2_reach: Original per-consumer compact clock-sink placement groups retained during GPL; initial native landing ring spans and fixed hard-child/pin shapes unchanged. Actual reach and postrepair drift measured at gate.
safe_design_checklist.3_fanout: Source semantics and connectivity identical9873 full native32 path, canonical helpers from current main; gate repeats exact Liberty census.
safe_design_checklist.4_depth: No logical cell/register/datapath/timing constraint change; same REGROOT_MODE9, landed K2/D4 crossings and +6 original t_out price. No new edge.
safe_design_checklist.5_storage: 19 exact hard children NK/18 NL with original pin contracts and43.2 origins; node binding actual CLOSED NB1 record with exact inherited geometry, original provenance marker retained historically.
safe_design_checklist.6_floorplan: Same820.8x907.2 hard layout and actual legal rows. Source FF reservations shape GPL only; opening adjacent repair row capacity fixes illegal wire placements causally at max3.4um displacement/0percentHPWL on actual failedODB.
safe_design_checklist.7_clock: ONE core clock ck entered at 38 interior tap pins (R4 grid 400 um + v6 sink additions); face (pin) flop spread <= 80 ps TT+FF on RC and mean within 80 of 250 is the hard rule; per-tree insertion / sinks per tap are guidance.
safe_design_checklist.8_reset: Original two-edge reset landing and max32 relay splitting unchanged; no reset/data contract modification.
